name: CI/CD
note: Questions authored by Claude as practice material. Not sourced from your own notes or any official exam. Verify anything you doubt against the docs.

questions.q: Where do GitHub Actions workflow files live?
Which trigger lets you start a workflow by hand from the Actions tab?
questions.why: workflow_dispatch adds a Run workflow button.

questions.q: How should you provide an API token to a workflow?
options: Store it as a repository secret and reference ${{ secrets.NAME }}
Pass it in the commit message
questions.why: Secrets are encrypted and masked in logs.

questions.q: By default, how do jobs in one workflow run?
options: In parallel, unless one declares needs:
In random order, one at a time
The runner machine type, such as ubuntu-latest
questions.why: It picks the runner image the job executes on.

questions.q: Which action keeps a test report so you can download it after the run?
questions.why: upload-artifact stores files from the run.

questions.q: Which trigger runs a workflow when a pull request is opened or updated?
What do Playwright tests usually need on a fresh CI runner before they run?
options: npx playwright install --with-deps to get browsers
questions.why: CI images may lack the browsers and system libraries.

questions.q: How does a workflow step make the whole run fail?
options: It exits with a non-zero exit code
It writes a file named fail
questions.why: Test runners return non-zero on failure and that fails the step.

questions.q: You want the report uploaded even when tests fail. What do you add to the upload step?
questions.why: if: always() runs the step regardless of earlier failures.
